description: This file defines a custom ViewGroup called FoldingLayout for Android, implementing a folding animation with multiple configurable folds, orientations, and anchor points. It manages the layout, appearance, and transformation matrices to create a real-time folding effect on its single child view.

classes.name: FoldingLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup for rendering a folding animation effect with configurable parameters such as fold count, orientation, and anchor point.

methods.name: setFoldListener
methods.description: Registers a callback to listen for fold start and end events.

methods.name: setFoldFactor
methods.description: Updates the fold factor (0 to 1) and recalculates transformation matrices.

methods.name: setOrientation
methods.description: Sets the fold orientation (VERTICAL or HORIZONTAL) and updates the layout accordingly.

methods.name: setAnchorFactor
methods.description: Sets the anchor point factor (relative position) for the fold.

methods.name: setNumberOfFolds
methods.description: Specifies the number of folds for the folding effect.

methods.name: updateFold
methods.description: Recalculates fold parameters and matrices based on current settings.

methods.name: prepareFold
methods.description: Prepares the fold configuration, segmenting the child view into parts and setting up matrices.

methods.name: calculateMatrices
methods.description: Calculates transformation matrices for each fold segment based on the fold factor.

methods.name: dispatchDraw
methods.description: Handles custom drawing of each fold segment with transformations and shadows to produce the folding effect.
